prompt_fragment: This asset is a top-down hex tile. Compose it for clear map readability, with the terrain filling the frame evenly and no horizon line.
raw_description:
Orthographic top-down view of pale tundra — wind-packed snow broken by
sparse patches of rust-colored lichen and low frozen scrub, faint game
trails winding through.

formatted_prompt.scene: Ink and watercolor hex tile, orthographic top-down view of wind-packed tundra terrain on aged vellum parchment, pale snow broken by rust lichen and frost-scrub, accented with warm ember and slate shadow.

subjects.description: Wind-packed snow field, cracked and slightly uneven, faint winding game trails pressed into the surface as shallow grooves.
subjects.position: fills entire frame edge to edge

subjects.description: Scattered low clusters of rust-colored lichen and frozen woody scrub, irregular organic shapes distributed across the snow, sparse and asymmetric.
subjects.position: distributed across mid and corner zones
